name: std::layout_left::mapping<Extents>::stride

declarations.code: constexpr index_type stride(rank_type i) const noexcept;

intro:
Returns the stride of the mapping at a rank index i. Equivalent to return extents().fwd-prod-of-extents(i);.

This overload participates in overload resolution only if extents_type::rank() > 0 is true.

The behavior is undefined if i >= extents_type::rank() is true.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
i

 -

 a rank index in the range [0, extents_type::rank())

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The stride at a specified rank index.
